committed_before: the first REAL trial of this lane (builds, unit runs and a Driver-free fixture smoke precede it)
hypothesis: On upstream main a9baa8d10 the idle X11 agent-cursor overlay is unmapped, and a native click's cursor reveal maps it during the guarded AT-SPI action (trycua/cua PR 4529, 5e13eb777). focus_guard::mapped_popups counts every VIEWABLE override-redirect root child, so it counts the Driver's own overlay as a new popup, sets grab_held_by and skips the focus restore. F20 (the overlay module registers the exact X11 ids of the windows it creates; mapped_popups skips those ids) removes the false popup and restores the guard rows without hiding real popups.

fix.name: F20
fix.rejected_alternative: title-prefix rule as in tools/impl_.rs:983 ('Cua.' on a pid-less window): any client can name an override-redirect popup 'Cua.*' (and many toolkits set no _NET_WM_PID on popups), which would hide a real keyboard grab. Built only as the control binary G0m8T.

G0m8A.recipe: a9baa8d10 + revert of 5e13eb777 (3b3f18ba0; clean, no conflict; overlay.rs equals 5e13eb777^) + the G0m chain, WITHOUT F20

G0m8T.recipe: G0m8 + the rejected title rule in mapped_popups (control only, never a candidate)

harness.packet: harness/run_rows.sh (derived from the original run_all.sh: queued-EXCLUSIVE yield, >= 30 s spacing, flock -s -o, FIX-20O receipts, focus-log env), harness/focuslog/sitecustomize.py (fixture focus log), harness/popup_fixture.py + popup_harness.py + popup_entry.sh (POPUP and INTEGRITY rows), harness/passes.json (role -> binary per pass), harness/plans/*.json
harness.environment: hostless + hostless-strict, cua-x11-session.sh (private Xvfb + openbox + picom, private session bus and AT-SPI bus, CUA_SESSION_ATSPI=1), telemetry off, no provider (non-loopback connects refused and counted)

oracle: The fixture's own focus log (focus_in / focus_out per GtkWindow, written by the fixture) plus the final X input focus / _NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW read by an independent observer client (2 ms FocusSampler), plus the fixture state file for the action effect. Never the Driver receipt alone. A restore counts only when the original analyzer's definition holds AND the fixture log shows the task window lost and regained the focus (fx_restored).
